record.title: 8x8 ToF module on the HAT's Stemma J5 (JST-SH 4-pin: GND, 3V3, SDA, SCL) — VL53L5CX or VL53L8CX, breakout board unidentified

requires.name: GND
requires.cite: research/raw/deploy_audio_i2c3-pihat.dts:10 — a Stemma/Qwiic-class 4-pin JST-SH carries GND, V+, SDA, SCL (part:conn-jst-sh-1mm on the workshop shelf)

requires.name: 3V3
requires.current_from_basis: the die's active-ranging figure (95 mA derived sum, part:vl53l5cx); the breakout's own regulator/level shifter, if any, is CANNOT DETERMINE. If the fitted part is the L8CX its figures differ (part:vl53l8cx).

requires.name: SDA
requires.address_quote: I2C: 400 kHz to 1 MHz serial bus, address: 0x52

requires.name: SCL
requires.quote: 8×8 at 15 Hz ('about 5 % of a 400 kHz bus')

uncertainties: Which generation ships (L5CX vs L8CX) and which breakout: CANNOT DETERMINE (docs §6, open question 6).
Position: MJCF `tof` site at world (81.4, 22.4, 249.1) mm — 22.4 mm left of the camera (docs §6).
record.note: The 'compact LiDAR'. On I2C3 with the codec (0x18) and the dormant BMI088 (0x19/0x68); no address collision among the four.
record.written: 2026-09-02, wiring lane (GOAL.md rung 5). Every figure names the document it came from; a figure with no document is null and says so.
